concerns: The reading for {子育|こそだ} is incorrect. The standard reading for 子育て is こそだて, so the kanji portion 子育 should be read as こそだて, not こそだ. The okurigana is て, so the reading should be こそだ.
The reading for {両立|りょうり} is incorrect. The standard reading for 両立 is りょうりつ, so the kanji portion 両立 should be read as りょうりつ, not りょうり. The okurigana is つ, so the reading should be りょうりつ.
The reading for {共稼|ともかせ} is incorrect. The standard reading for 共稼ぎ is ともかせぎ, so the kanji portion 共稼 should be read as ともかせぎ, not ともかせ. The okurigana is ぎ, so the reading should be ともかせ.
